title: State ledger of the notes
description: One JSON line per tracked note in state/notes-status.jsonl: the state of a note of a frozen ledger, which is never edited, or of a finding of a critical panel that became a correction. The validator (p-notes) requires exactly one line per note of the ledger passed with --notes, and a version in closed_in for a closing status. Since v0.6.0 it is append-only: a change of status is a new line carrying prev (the hash chain), the last line of a ref is its state, and the lines written before v0.6.0 are never edited (until then a change of status edited the line).

ref.description: 'notes:<n>', the n-th note (1-based, in file order) of the ledger passed with --notes, or 'panel:<version>:<id>', a finding of the critical panel that reviewed that version.

closed_in.description: The method version that closed it, or, in a cell, the cell's version label (e.g. v2, since v0.6.0); required for fixed and out of scope.

summary.description: What the note asked and where it was closed, or why it stays open; one line.

prev.description: Since v0.6.0: the sha256 of every line above this one, each followed by LF; the validator recomputes the chain. A chained line may restate a ref already listed: the last line of a ref is its state.

escaped.description: Since v0.6.0: the note is a regression that escaped every gate (golden rule 4). Closed, it names the gate it became ('gate') or the recorded reason not to make one ('no_gate').

gate.description: The gate an escaped regression became.

no_gate.description: Why an escaped regression did not become a gate (a rule moved into a contract, a defect no code can read): at least 8 words, a measure of its form and not of its content, unless 'decision' names a decided owner decision.

decision.description: Since the closing pass of v0.6.0: the exact name of a decided entry of the owner's decisions that stands for the reason not to make a gate; a substring of a name no longer counts.

opened_in.description: The version the note was opened in, when the ref does not say it (a panel ref carries it; a note of the frozen ledger was opened in 0.1.0).

due.description: Since v0.6.0: the version an open note is scheduled for; an open note older than the declared limit of rounds and not scheduled is a low note.

severity.description: The severity of a tracked finding that is not a note of the ledger (whose severity is read there).

affects.description: Since v0.6.0: the ids of the brief's non-negotiables the note affects; an open high or blocking note that affects one is blocking unless an owner decision that is decided covers it.
